name: io.github.wilsonvargas/driftcheck
title: Driftcheck
description: Compares a mobile app screen (Android or iOS Simulator) with its Figma design and suggests fixes.

environmentVariables.name: FIGMA_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Figma Personal Access Token (scope File content: Read-only). Optional if you export frames with the Driftcheck Figma plugin.

environmentVariables.name: DRIFTCHECK_OUTPUT
environmentVariables.description: Folder for captures, reports and the Figma cache. Default: driftcheck in the temp folder.

environmentVariables.name: DRIFTCHECK_EXPORTS
environmentVariables.description: Folder where Figma plugin exports are looked up. Default: Downloads.
